task.problem_statement: Users need an explicit matrix representation of an OpenQAOA Hamiltonian, including sums of mixed Pauli terms acting on nonadjacent qubits, to compare and manipulate the corresponding quantum operator.
requirements: Expose the Hamiltonian as a sparse matrix in the repository computational-basis convention.
Combine Pauli terms with their coefficients while preserving tensor-product ordering and complex phases.
Preserve existing Hamiltonian and Pauli-operator behavior.

interface.Name: Hamiltonian.as_matrix
interface.Description: Property returning the Hamiltonian matrix; supports toarray() for dense conversion.
